question: How can a teacher reset a student password in Clever?
answer:
## How a Teacher Can Reset a Student Password in Clever

This feature is only available **if your school district has enabled it**. If you don't see the options below, contact your school's tech support.

### Steps to Reset a Student's Password:

1. Log in to your **Teacher Portal**
2. Click on **My Students** in the left-side menu
3. Select **Student Roster**
4. Filter by class if needed, then click on the specific student
5. On the right side of the Portal, under the student's name, locate **Student Tools**
6. Click **Set new password**
7. Enter the new password for the student

Once completed, the student can log in with the new password. Depending on your district's settings, this may reset the password for **multiple login methods** (e.g., both Clever and Google passwords).

> ⚠️ **Note:** If you do not see the **Set new password** option, your district has not enabled this feature. Contact your school's tech support for assistance.

Additionally, if your school has enabled it, **students may also be able to reset their own passwords** — your district settings determine this.

---

**Source:** [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612?language=en_US)
